app.name: Xiao Liu Ren Lab
app.positioning: A calm learning tool for understanding Xiao Liu Ren, a classical Chinese symbolic method.
app.principle: The tool explains symbolic meanings. The user makes their own judgment.

home.headline: Explore Xiao Liu Ren through symbolic meanings and reflective questions.
home.supportingCopy: A calm learning tool for understanding Xiao Liu Ren, a classical Chinese symbolic method.
home.boundary: For cultural learning and personal reflection, not deterministic fortune-telling.
home.guideNote: The guide is hosted on an external download page. No email is required.

startHere.title: Start Here
startHere.boundary: This tool does not make decisions for you. It presents traditional symbolic meanings and reflection prompts so you can consider the situation yourself.
startHere.notFor: Do not use this tool for medical, legal, financial, emergency, gambling, or pregnancy decisions.

tool.title: Cast a Reflection
tool.intro: Choose a context, time, and time zone. The topic is optional and stays local.
tool.reflectionTopicPlaceholder: Optional: What are you reflecting on?
tool.reflectionTopicNote: Optional. This stays on this page and is not included in analytics or sharing.
tool.timeZoneNote: This tool uses your local time zone by default. You can change it if you want to cast the reading for another location.
tool.timeZoneHelp: For personal reflection, use the time zone where you are when asking the question. For a matter tied to a specific place, you may choose the time zone of that place.

casting.reducedMotion: Motion is reduced. Showing the static calculation steps.

result.disclaimer: This reading is for cultural learning and personal reflection. It is not medical, legal, financial, or professional advice.
result.patternTemplate: This pattern begins with {monthTheme}, moves through {dayTheme}, and brings attention to {hourTheme}. The final palace emphasizes {finalTheme}.

method.title: Method Used in This Tool
method.intro: This is a learning tool, not a claim of one true method.
method.traditionsNote: Xiao Liu Ren has multiple casting traditions. This tool currently uses one fixed method for learning consistency: the lunar month-day-hour method. Other teachers or traditions may count differently, use different timing rules, or interpret palace positions in different ways.

sixPalaces.title: The Six Palaces
sixPalaces.subtitle: Symbolic states, not lucky or unlucky labels.
